scenario.goal_zh: 明确不用真实爆炸效果并安排通过镜头和录音表现。

context_zh: 学生短片导演与演员核对一段只需暗示事件的镜头。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: The script says there is an explosion outside. Are we filming one?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: No. Nothing should actually explode on set. We will add a recorded sound later.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: What do you need me to do when I hear it?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: You will not hear it during filming. I will say your cue, and you look towards the window.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: So the camera stays on my reaction, and the event is never shown.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Exactly. Let us rehearse the look once, without any effects.
